description: Voltformer helps users search electrical equipment, compare transformer specifications, read technical articles and perform preliminary engineering calculations. Connect a Voltformer account to manage projects, company profiles and product shortlists; create and edit single-line diagrams; run available studies; export drawings; and submit quotation requests after confirmation. Country profiles and material or electricity references include source dates and limitations. Engineering results require qualified review and do not constitute design approval or a purchase order.
